reviews.text:
We had such a great experience with SVS in Lynwood. My fur baby Roo needed extensive dental surgery with multiple extractions, and everyone there was kind, professional and attentive throughout the entire process.

The facility is immaculate and very well organized. I was also really impressed by how thorough and detail-oriented they were with Roo’s aftercare and making sure I understood what to expect once we got home.

I especially appreciate the level of client care. Whenever I called, someone actually answered the phone and took the time to talk with me and answer my questions. After having experiences with other veterinary offices where I was constantly put on hold or had a hard time reaching someone, that really made a difference.

It is a bit of a drive for me, but completely worth it. I’ve tried several vets closer to home and unfortunately found them overcrowded, chaotic and incredibly expensive. The experience at SVS has been completely different. The drive is well worth it for the level of care, organization and attention Roo receives.

I’m so grateful to have found such great care for my furbaby and to know she’s in good hands.

Our dog recently injured her back leg on a Friday and needed TPLO surgery. I honestly cannot thank Simon Veterinary Surgical – Lynwood enough for how quickly they stepped up to help us.

I'm not sure who I spoke with on the phone, but whoever she was, she was absolutely AMAZING. She went above and beyond to help us secure a surgery date as soon as possible. She was responsive, knowledgeable, and even made herself available until 9PM! It genuinely felt like I was speaking directly with the doctor in charge because she knew exactly what she was talking about and actually cared about getting our dog the help she needed.

What makes this place stand out is that there are NO games. No unnecessary back-and-forth with receptionists, no ridiculous hidden fees, no endless prescreening charges, and no AI or robot answering your calls. Just real human interaction with people who know what they're doing.

We contacted other veterinary hospitals that wanted us to pay for multiple preliminary appointments and screening fees before even discussing surgery dates. To this day, some of them still haven't gotten back to us. Meanwhile, Simon Veterinary Surgical got straight to the point, communicated clearly, and helped us when we needed it most.

The doctors here are incredibly competent, their pricing is excellent, and the hospital itself is exceptionally clean and professional. You can tell these people specialize in what they do, and they do it extremely well.

If your dog needs TPLO or any other serious orthopedic surgery, I cannot recommend this place enough. In my opinion, this is hands down one of the BEST veterinary surgical hospitals in California. You get experienced professionals, transparent pricing, outstanding customer service, and, most importantly, people who genuinely care about your pet.

Thank you again for accommodating us on such short notice and making an incredibly stressful situation so much easier for our family. We are beyond grateful. 10/10 experience. I would recommend this hospital to anyone without hesitation!

Dr. Simon and her team took great care of my pup who needed TPLO surgery. They care about their patients and actively follow up, Additionally, their pricing was  way better than the “McDonald Donald’s of Vet care”!

I’ve brought all three of my dogs here for dental work over the years, and they are truly the best! The staff is amazing, caring, and always makes me feel like my dogs are in great hands. We wouldn’t go anywhere else!!!!
Stormi, Jak, and Dax are always in great hands!

Simon Vet Clinic saved our dog

My Pets are like my children❤️ and so we want only the best. That is why I highly recommend Dr. Simon and Simon Veterinary Clinic.
Our dog Sparky was a badly injured rescue. His two front paws were shattered. In 2020 Dr Simon performed 3 life saving very intricate orthopedic surgeries over 4 months to piece together his badly injured front paws.
Fast forward to 2026 and he is living his best life. Sparky has fully recovered and can walk. Recently he re-injured his left paw and was unable to put pressure on it. Other Drs had not provided a positive outcome and we were prepared for the worst. Due to the seriousness of his past paw injuries, we decided to seek out Dr. Simon for a consultation and second opinion. Her office is a 4 to 6 hour drive round trip for us. Since she had saved him previously, we decided she was the most qualified and we would do what she recommended.
Dr Simon took her own X-rays and blood work for analysis. She informed us that he did not have bone cancer but it was the remnants of an old bone infection in his left that caused his paw bones to be unstable and painful. She recommended surgery to clean the area up and fusing the joint to get him back on his feet. In addition, it was a very reasonable flat rate cost for the surgery that included everything…Surgery. Meds. Follow ups. And Rehab! Absolutely the best treatment plan and pricing we had been given by any of the previous Drs.
Without a doubt, Dr Simon and her staff are compassionate wonderful people that have our furbaby’s best interest at heart. I don’t have enough good things to say about Dr. Simon and her Veterinary Clinic. Her care for our furbaby was unmatched.

Our dog had to have two TPLO surgeries almost back to back in Spring and Summer of this year, and the whole staff at SVS were incredible. From making sure we were prepared with the info we needed to making sure our dog had the care and meds that she needed, they were the best! We could not recommend a better place to take your dog.

My dog, Clover, has been under Dr. Simon’s care for luxating patella. Dr. Simon and her team have been nothing short of amazing throughout the surgery and healing process. After our initial consult, Dr. Simon explained the immediate need for surgery and added Clover to her schedule the same day! She took the time from her busy surgical schedule to explain all of the possible options and outcomes while also considering cost and recovery time. Dr. Simon’s team of therapists and techs have been caring and informative. They take the time needed to meet with you so you can confidently care for your pup after surgery. They are quick to respond to calls and texts to answer questions, give instructions or provide reassurance. The office staff has also been prompt in providing paperwork needed for insurance coverage. I can’t recommend Dr. Simon and her team enough. They provide quality, affordable care for their patients!

We have taken our Dauchshund here for multiple surgeries and each experience has been amazing. Every employee treats our baby with genuine care and takes time to answer all the questions we have. Best of all, they have always done their best to provide their services at an affordable price. Bringing our dog here has improved his quality of life and we are forever greatful.

I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Simon and her entire team!

I brought my 4 pound Pomeranian in for a complex cryptorchidism surgery along with baby teeth extractions. I was extremely nervous about putting him under anesthesia again, especially because his first surgery with his primary veterinarian had unfortunately been unsuccessful. I really did not want to put my baby through another surgery, so I had a lot of anxiety leading up to it.

Mara was incredibly reassuring and supportive throughout the process, and on the day of surgery, Dr. Simon personally spoke with me and immediately lifted so much weight off my shoulders. She made me feel completely confident that my baby was in the safest hands.

The surgery was completed in under 40 minutes, which absolutely amazed me! Even more importantly, his recovery was incredible. He experienced no discomfort and was back to himself so quickly, especially compared to his difficult recovery from his first surgery.

Dr. Simon is truly an amazing surgeon, and her knowledge, skill, and ability to reassure worried pet parents are unmatched. I am so grateful to her, Mara, and the entire team for taking such wonderful care of my baby. ❤️
Amazing place to take your pet! The staff is incredibly friendly, caring, and provides great service. They made the whole experience easy and comfortable. Highly recommend!

Two months ago, our 2 y.o ginger tabby, Louie, stopped his usual acrobatics and started dragging his hind legs. We were alarmed to hear that he had somehow fractured both hips, and that he was in need of a bilateral FHO surgery. Louie is our baby and he was in a great deal of pain. Simon Veterinary Surgical was referred to us by our vet, and from the moment we called, Nate was calming and reassuring. He was upfront about surgical pricing (FHO surgery is not cheap) - but their pricing is very fair and all-inclusive - (including all related medications, plus weekly check-ups during the recovery period and physio to get him back on his 'feet'). They also provide ongoing customer service, with help just a text or phonecall away.
When we called to schedule Louie's surgery, Mara was incredibly compassionate and got us in the very next day. The day of the surgery, Dr. Simon came out to reassure us and talk us through the plan - she made us feel so taken care of and was both empathetic and encouraging.
Louie's surgery was a complete success. The whole team at Simon Surgical held our hands throughout the whole process - guiding us as we made several calls in the days following the operation, making sure Louie was comfortable, and providing a very comprehensive guide to post-op care (including online videos for exercises). Lo, their physical therapist, was incredible - making sure Louie was healing well and working his muscles, and she went above and beyond to ensure that after the four weeks of treatment, Louie was well and truly on the road to a complete recovery. They even helped us navigate our insurance claim for the surgery.
I can't imagine what we would have done without Dr. Simon and her team. Louie is our baby, and thanks to them, we expect him to be back to his parkour antics in no time. I'll be forever grateful.
Excellent. A surgeon with a heart, takes time to explain and does a good job on your best friend- your dog. Highly recommend.
Amazing experience. Always attention to detail and very caring! We are repeating customers.

My little guy needed a TPLO on his only bag leg an my primary vet said they couldn’t do it because he’s a tripod, and the folks and Simon Veterinary were ready to take him and took excellent care of him. They sat with me for all my questions, and I love that they’re so involved with post surgery care and rehab. Responses have been very timely so far and it’s clear they care a ton about the animals, and the owners who are nervous for their pet. I feel like I left with everything I need to take good care of my pup. Even a carefully laid out PT plan and a meds schedule with check marks, exactly what I would have asked for tbh as the aftercare is a lot to keep track of, but Simon Veterinary made it so much easier to wrap my head around. Plus, with everything included, it felt like a truly amazing price especially compared to the research I’ve done about this surgery. Cannot recommend them enough!

SVS saved our girl’s toe from amputation!

Ellie, our foster rescue dog had a broken toe that refused to heal. After another orthopedic specialist quoted $10,000+ to *attempt* a surgical repair on her toe, we were desperate to find another option and avoid amputation unless absolutely necessary since it was a weight-bearing toe.

Thank God I found SVS. They were able to do her surgery the very next day and at less than half the cost with WAY more post-op support. They provided high-quality supplements for the first 1-2 weeks post-op PLUS weekly electromagnetic treatments to encourage bone growth — these were not even offered by the first specialist we saw and at SVS they were not just recommended but included in the total treatment cost so there were no hidden fees!!

AND in the event that the toe would not heal despite the surgery and treatments, SVS would do the amputation at no additional cost. I WAS SHOCKED AND IN TEARS.

Because SVS operates out of another hospital facility, they don’t have a waiting room, which for a dog rescuer like me is of no importance. While their staff is very caring, some can be a little crusty or curt—probably from working with frustrating pet parents. I’ll take high-quality care, transparency and affordability over a waiting room and posh customer service any day!!!

All that to say, SVS saved our girl’s toe from amputation!! On her last visit, they did a x-ray check (also included in the upfront cost!) and the x-ray wasn’t showing signs of growth progress. However, on the day we brought her in for an amputation, Ellie was putting weight on the foot. Because of this, Dr. Simon recommended we not do the amputation and let her start to take slow, short walks. Sure enough, within a few more weeks Ellie was walking normally again!

Today she loves to run, jump, and play — and FAST! Ellie has since been adopted into a loving forever home 💕

Highly recommend Dr. Simon and Team, she preformed TPLO surgery on my 15 yr old maltepoo, today he’s 19yrs old and enjoys his walks and zummies.
Roxanna V.
(Walking advertisement)

I brought my dog Drip in for an emergency visit and I must say, not only did all the staff work with all the inconvenience thrown their way, but everyone, especially the vets, had exceptional control of the situation, as well as 10/10 communication skills, informing me of everything, included a much needed breakdown of Drip's recovery procedure. I am forever in debt to Simon Veterinary Surgical, and although I pray I never run into an emergency like that again, I am glad to know that they have my back!
Simply the best service and surgery

Absolutely WONDERFUL customer service. I’ve never felt so reassured and comfortable leaving my dog in someone’s hands. Their work is impeccable and my dog had both legs done for
TPLO. He’s doing great. Thank you!

Very helpful when i couldn't afford my dogs surgery they are the only ones who helped me and they continue to be helpful throughout the years I'm very thankful for vets like Simon and there team my doggo wouldn't have the proper care she needs without them and I'm forever grateful ❤️

AMAZING DOCTOR
AMAZING TEAM
THANK YOU SO MUCH ❤️💜❤️
SIMON VETERINARY SURGICAL PROS
💯

YES!!!!!! ABSOLUTELY CONSIDER THIS VET SURGEON FOR YOUR PETS ORTHO NEEDS!!!!!! They are the standard for honest, good treatment.

No private equity here, just good professional folks trying to run a small business while doing the common folk right.

Flat rate for hip luxation surgery, meds, and rehab

Doctor Simon is a subject matter expert in both rehab and vet ortho and does not BS around with her position or skills. She’s top notch and must be trusted if you want success.

The staff is also top notch. They were so willing to help over the phone, and were VERY informative. I honestly wouldn’t have came to them for help if it wasn’t for who ever helped me over the phone on Saturday and Sunday.

Nothing but great things to say about the team! My dog Evie had TPLO on both knees and the process went so smoothly! The price was amazing for all that comes with it. Nathan is amazing! The whole team!

I had a terrible experience with this clinic. The setup is highly unprofessional—they operate out of a rented room with no receptionist, forcing you to wait in the parking lot. Once they had my money, the service vanished. I was given weird, flat-rate pricing instead of an itemized bill, and the staff was so disorganized they actually told me to "remind them" to schedule my own appointments.

The medical care was equally careless. They forgot to send us home with necessary pain meds and failed to document my dog's incision. When my pet’s health declined and I called for help, I was funneled to a customer service manager named NATHAN (aka "Nate"). He was shockingly unprofessional; he started shouting at me over the phone and hung up when I asked questions. It took forever just to get them to release my records to a real vet. Please do your research before trusting them with your pet.

UPDATE [May 11, 2026]: Note the owner’s response below. They admit they are "reusing" a canned reply from a previous conflict rather than addressing the specific medical failures I experienced (lack of pain meds, missing records, and unprofessional conduct by their manager, Nathan).

Most disturbingly, they have resorted to a defamatory script accusing me of being abusive to my wife, calling her my "kicking bag." This is a complete and malicious fabrication. My wife was with me for support, and we are both horrified that a medical facility would weaponize false claims of domestic violence to silence a customer who asked for an itemized bill.

A look at their Yelp page shows this is their standard pattern: when they fail medically, they attack the client personally. I am currently pursuing this as a case of libel per se. If they are willing to lie about a customer’s character to protect their rating, imagine what they are willing to hide regarding your pet’s health.

My dog Elliott got Medial Luxating Patella surgery on one of his knees here at Simon Vet Surgical on Feb 2026. Dr. Simon and team were absolutely wonderful to work with. They answered all my questions patiently and I did not feel rushed or dismissed. They provided me with meds, vitamins and paperwork during his 8-week recovery and I was able to text them anytime with questions. Lo and team were amazing during his physical therapy.

I was quoted nearly 12k by VCA since my dog needs both his knees operated and I was encouraged to operate on both knees at the same time. Dr. Simon quoted me a little over $7k for both and encouraged me to operate on one knee at a time. She said she priced it that way because she didn't not want finances to affect a pet owner's decisions for their pets. Words can't describe how glad I am to have taken her advice. Recovery is not easy, especially in the first two weeks, and I can easily imagine the complications my dog averted by us doing one knee only. I will absolutely return here next year when we do Elliott's other knee.

Thank you Dr. Simon, lovely Lo, and every other staff member at Simon Veterinary Surgical. You made me feel like you really had my dog's best interest at heart and for something as emotional as decisions around my son/dog's health, I left feeling empowered and at peace.

I had such an amazing experience with my dog at Simon in Sherman Oaks.  She had a BOAS surgery and the drop off/check in process was so easy,  They texted me updates on her progress and I was able to pick her up within three hours of dropping her off.  The staff were courteous and knowlegdeable.   Her surgery went well and she can breath so much better!  Thanks to everyone at Simon.

Simon Vet Surgical took excellent care of Bonnie during her TPLO surgery. What stood out to me right away was their upfront, all-in quote—it covered the surgery, medications, and follow-up visits, so there were no surprise costs.

Their efficiency was also impressive. After I emailed Bonnie’s X-rays, I had a diagnosis and quote within 24 hours, and was able to schedule her surgery before I would have even gotten in for a consult elsewhere.

Bonnie recovered beautifully, and we’re so grateful to the talented surgical team for getting her back to doing what she loves-running and chasing balls- within just a few months.

I would highly recommend Simon Vet Surgical to anyone considering TPLO surgery for their dog. I hope we don't need any more surgeries in the future, but if we do, I know who to call.

Came from the vet whos been tresting ny dog with a broken leg, who then told me my dog has a broken heel or something wrong that she cant see. Came here the same day and didnt realize they dont take walk-ins; however Nathan took me in right away. I had brought xrays of my own, but ended up needing more xrays. Got those done and got the good news that my puppy was fine. After being nervous on the drive there and thinking my pup would need some sort of surgery at 6 months was really throwing me off, and im glad I was able to get seen when they were busy and accommodate me the same day. Very grateful.

Absolutely amazing surgeons and amazing follow-up. Our dog had a TPLO/MPL done here and I can't imagine getting it done anywhere else. This is actually our second surgery with them and they are the best and most fairly priced we've come across.

Our precious pup Coco thanks you guys! ❤️🐶

I LOVE this surgeon's office! We found them 3 years ago when my Chihuahua tore her CCL in her left leg, and my husband and I swore we'd never go to another surgeon after. They fixed her CCL and her luxating patella, and soon enough, she was back to jumping around, running at full speed playing fetch within a few months.
Then she tore her right CCL a couple weeks ago, and so we immediately looked them up again and reached out. They gave us a free consultation AND honored the price we paid three years ago since she had already gotten surgery done there before for the same thing. Everyone at this surgeon's office genuinely cares about your pet, and we dropped her off today with zero worry because of how wonderful they are! I recommend this surgeon's office to everyone, and will continue to do so! ❤️

5/5 Stars – Exceptional Care, Transparent Pricing, and a True Recovery Plan!

If you are looking for top-tier surgical care for your pet, look no further than Simon Veterinary Surgical. After our 12-year-old Shiba tore her CCL on a Friday morning, we were frantic to find help. From the moment we called and spoke to Nathan, we knew we were in good hands. He was incredibly kind, informative, and helpful, managing to get us a same day surgery appointment as soon as the following Monday in Lynwood. We opted for the Sherman Oaks location on Tuesday, and the experience was seamless from start to finish.

The level of service here is unmatched. When we arrived, two staff members met us in the parking lot. Since our dog couldn’t walk due to the pain, one of them even carried her inside—a small gesture that meant the world to us. We knew she was in good hands. After X-rays and an exam confirmed the tear, Dr. Simon met with us personally to walk us through the procedure and the recovery process. Remarkably, our dog had surgery that morning and was ready to be picked up by noon! This same-day pickup is an added benefit; while other clinics often require a one or two-night stay, our dog was able to avoid waking up in a strange location and instead rested and recovered at home where she is most comfortable.

What truly sets Dr. Simon apart is the focus on rehabilitation. This was our dog’s second CCL tear; the first time we went to a different surgical center, and they barely mentioned rehab beyond "gradually increasing her walks." Consequently, she still sits with that first leg held out straight. Dr. Simon noticed this immediately and provided us with specific rehab exercises to ensure she regains full function this time around. It is clear they care about the long-term quality of life for your pet, not just the surgery itself.

Lastly, let’s talk about the pricing. Other locations gave us vague quotes with $5,000 gaps between the minimum and maximum price. Simon Veterinary Surgical offers refreshing flat-rate pricing, which includes the exam, surgery, and all follow-up appointments. It is an incredible added benefit to receive this level of top-class, expert service for a price that was actually less than every other location we called!

The service was excellent, and everyone was so friendly throughout the entire process. If we ever need surgical care again, Dr. Simon will be our very first stop. We cannot recommend them enough!

My dog Emmory broke her arm I called the guy I spoke to was very understanding and very helpful told me I could bring her in the very next day in the am I picked my dog up around 1pm she was still sleepy but she was all fixed up gave me meds and supplements to help keep her strong and she made a full recovery in about a months time and she hasn't had any problems since I really appreciate the prompt response and excellent service.

This review is LONG overdue…

Huge thank you to Dr. Simon and her team. Everyone was thorough, kind, and informative.

My dog tore her CCL and I frantically began searching…especially because our baby’s a senior and we didn’t want her to be in pain. I had called multiple places for quotes and they either didn’t respond, or the quotes we got were $7k+ in facilities that looked cramped. I called Simon Vet and Mara explained everything to me.

Not even a week later, we brought my dog in for surgery. Everything was done in one day, and her follow ups have been good. Literally everything was included in the quote given. Recovery was so tough because my dog loves to run and is very active…and she refused all the meds…but whenever I called and texted with concerns, either Mara or Nathan got back to me.

My dog’s still recovering, but she is so happy and is back to wagging her tail and play attacking our cats (lol).

Thank you guys so much.

These people are absolute angels!! They took incredible care of my kitty who needed a LOT of teeth pulled. Straight up good, animal people who believe animals deserve the same amount and quality of care as humans!

My dog got in a car accident and he was run over by a car and his left hind leg’s bone was broken. They completed the surgery. The Doctors and Staff here did a great job and were helpful. I’m very thankful to the Staff and Doctors.

I run the dog rescue Pups without Borders. We are so grateful to have found Simon Surgical. We have had two dogs receive care here for leg fractures. We appreciated the up front costs, good communication, attention to care and overall amazing surgical expertise.  Both of our dogs are healed and living their best lives! Thank you Simon Surgical!

We have been fortunate to have been referred Dr. Simon by our family vet. The service is outstanding and they've taken care of two of our dogs. I would definitely recommend them. Thank you Dr. Simon AND team for the amazing work you do. Ana I.

They did an excellent job. Their quote was well below the exact same surgery somewhere else. The recovery plan was much better and faster than the first quote. Dudley followed the plan is back to 100%.
Excellent job!!!!

Wow. Since my darling daughter (cat) cannot call for medical care, I made an inquiry to Simon Vet Surgical to see if they would be the right fit for Pepper's ongoing and chronic ear issues. The practice manager, Mara, took so much good time and care to talk through recommendations and even provide vets who were a better fit. It's so hard to deal with our babies when they have a health crisis! Surgery is not the route for Pepper (yet) but SVS will be a first call if we have to go that route!

Long overdue review for Simon Vet Surgical! My Lola needed TPLO surgery back in September and I am so glad I went with them. She is now back to walking with her best friend. They make the process from start to finish super easy so it never feels like you are alone on your fur baby’s recovery. 10/10 recommend!

I ordered a product from them that my vet here in VA had recommended for my dog. I was impressed with their super-prompt communication with me regarding my order and their speed in getting it mailed to me.

Best place ever.  They love your dog as much as you do.  This is my dog’s second surgery here and if you have an animal you love… this is the only place to take them.  The staff is top notch.  The surgeon is top notch and care is top notch. Mara was amazing and just kept everything in order. My dog had surgery last night and today she is in great spirits. I just can’t say anymore about this place other than you can’t go wrong!  Other vets took over two months to figure what was wrong with Sunny’s knee.  Brought her here for a third opinion and she was in surgery immediately.  Then when Sunny ripped her other ACL they did a free consultation and she went into surgery the same day.  The post care is also included in the fee.  You don’t get this with other vets.  SVS is literally the 90210 of vets and vet care. Trust me… you can’t go wrong with SVS

Simon Vet Surgical is the only Vet we would trust with our precious kitties. We have rescued many cats over the years and and bringing them to the vet was always a stressful experience but Simon Vet is a godsend. They take the stress out of the process and I know when I hand over my fur baby they will get the best care possible. We have had 6 cats spayed and neutered at Simon and it was such a great experience. They take such good care of the patients and the aftercare is the best. Three cheers for Simon Vet Surgical!

I'm so happy because my dog ​​received such attention and, above all, the love and care she was shown. I returned after three years because Mila had undergone surgery, and once again my experience with the doctor and his assistants was just as pleasant as it was three years ago. I highly recommend them because your pet will be in very good hands and will receive the care they need!

I love this place and these people Dr Sherman and staff They fixed my cats mouth He had a large bubble under his tongue (ranula)He can eat and breathe now He is back to being playful and happy He just needs his teeth cleaned Their prices are great because they care!! They are the Best!!

This place is amazing. We took one dog here for a specialty surgery and it was amazing care no complaints no hidden fees, and my other dog they are seeing for the possibility to fix a surgery from another facility where we live 2 hours away and they answered all my questions and made us a next day appointment. They are absolutely the best priced, half of what almost everyone else wanted to charge. I REGRET not going back to them for the 2nd dog and now will only go to them.

Simon Veterinary Clinic is a high end specialized surgical center that employs loving, well trained professionals. I have had both of my dog's back legs surgically repaired with a modern TPLO procedure. I understanding it's like bypassing the ACL ligament so the dog does not have instability or pain while walking jumping running etc. My dog is about 6 years old and recovered wonderfully, there was a year and a half between surgeries. It's pricey but excellent! My dog is as good as new!

I had such a wonderful experience with Dr. Simon and his amazing team. They performed both FHO and MPL surgery on my Pomeranian, and the care we received was outstanding. The staff was attentive, patient, and incredibly thorough — they explained everything clearly and made sure my pup was comfortable and well cared for every step of the way. Dr. Simon’s skill, compassion, and professionalism gave me complete confidence throughout the process. I’m so grateful for their dedication and highly recommend them to anyone in need of top-quality veterinary surgical care!

Patricia Simon literally made my dog walk again!! As a puppy, I discovered that my Bert would go lame in one leg, and then lame in the other. After his examination, turned out he had luxating patellas (very common in toy Australian Shepherds). VCA quoted me $10,000 PER LEG! I called at least 8 other places until I found SVS. Dr. Simon's quote was less than 1/3 of the other estimates, AND they performed additional procedures to ensure Bert's smooth healing and recovery. I CANNOT GIVE A BETTER RECOMMENDATION to ANY other vet I've used in the past. The team is quick to respond, highly sensitive, and they all share a devotion to animals. Huge thumbs up!

Amazing Care for Our Rescue Dog, Bruno!
We can't say enough great things about this vet office! Our rescue dog, Bruno, came to us with some serious medical needs and required multiple surgeries. From the very beginning, the entire team was compassionate, professional, and incredibly skilled.
The doctor has done amazing work on Bruno every procedure was handled with care and expertise. He still has one more surgery to go, but we're already so thankful for everything they've done for him. It's clear they truly care about their patients and go above and beyond.
We're so glad we found this place. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy, knowledgeable, and kind veterinary team!

Great experience with everyone at Simon for my dog’s TPLO surgery. The pricing was fair and they did an excellent job of preparing me for every stage of the recovery. I’m now 12 weeks out and my dog is pretty much back to 100% mobility. Highly recommended.
Simon Veterinary is a great place to take your pet for surgical care. Their after care is amazing. They truly care about the well being of your pet.

Great team over here.
Had to bring my dog a handful of times playing whack a mole until he was finally stable. Yes it's a vet and it's going to cost money but I was surprised I did not have to pay more than I did. I'm grateful for the staff here and so is my pup.

Asked for medical records for my pet and the individual who answers the phone, I am assuming was NATHAN as other reviews have mentioned. Was very rude and treated me poorly, I simply asked for medical records to be sent to me of my pet that they have seen. Prior to getting ahold of somebody at their hospital, I kept calling and their phone kept saying "disconnected",  3 times (seems to me that whenever they get into disputes with customers or get "annoyed" of their customers as their responses indicate in past reviews, they block numbers... since when does a business block numbers ? and I was surprised because I genuinely do not recall ever getting into any dispute or problem for them to block my number- I was in disbelief from my point of view) anyways my call was finally able to go through after calling from another phone and I finally asked for medical records to be sent to me. After asking him, he hung up on me instantly while I was barely replying with a "Thank You". It is insane to me that this hospital tolerates this individual to answer phone calls as such and let alone let them respond to reviews by offending customers. As pet owners who want services or a simple favor of just getting medical records, there is no reason to be treated very poorly regardless of the circumstance (you may decline services to whomever, but giving customers attitude just because you are stressed, busy or upset is insane because we did nothing to you…). As you can see on previous reviews that this same individual blames everyone else for inconveniences rather than getting to the bottom of the problems. It is unprofessional how a business allows this type of behavior of "pettiness" (because that is what this individual has portrayed as you can see from previous reviews). Blaming and bashing customers in a business is immature and unprofessional, please do better and be more considerate of others than just making the customers feel worse than they already do with their sick pets.
